about_section.title: About Us
about_section.description: Ques is an artificial intelligence technology company based in Shenzhen. We build autonomous, self-improving agents that bring structure and precision to complex, uncertain environments.
about_section.mission_description: We build agent systems for domains where ambiguity is unavoidable and precision is essential. Our current work spans geolocation and quantitative trading, with each system designed to reason, adapt, and improve through experience.
about_section.vision_description: Our vision is to become the intelligence infrastructure that enables people and organizations to explore unfamiliar domains with greater clarity and confidence. We will expand this foundation into new fields where complexity, uncertainty, and decision quality matter.

products_section.title: Our Products
products_section.geoseer_description: GeoSeer is a sophisticated platform that uses cutting-edge AI to identify locations from uploaded images. Combining geoestimation models, multi-agent analysis, and reasoning verification, it provides unprecedented accuracy in image-based geolocation.
products_section.geoseer_feature_1: Fine-tuned geoestimation models for precise location detection
products_section.geoseer_feature_2: Multi-agent AI architecture with reverse engineering capabilities
products_section.geoseer_feature_3: Reasoning verification for validated, accurate results
